name: storyvalo-video-planner
description: Draft a five-scene video outline template from URL words or an idea, then continue in Storyvalo. The plugin does not read pages, save outlines, render, bill or publish.

interface.longDescription: Give Storyvalo a public URL or short idea. It returns a one-minute outline template: title, hook, five scenes and call to action, plus a link to continue in Storyvalo. It never fetches or reads the page. A URL defaults to the website workflow unless you explicitly request product or lesson. Only website prefills the URL; product and lesson outlines must be pasted or adapted in Storyvalo. The link does not save the outline. Nothing is rendered, generated, published or charged from the chat, and no Storyvalo account access is available. Only public http(s) URLs work; template text is English; Storyvalo's plans and limits apply when you render.
capabilities: Draft a five-scene template from URL words or an idea
Open the chosen workflow; website also prefills the URL
